intro: I am interested in the Sr. Software Engineer role with Innovative IT Solutions. My background aligns most strongly with the role's Python, PySpark/Spark, Hadoop/Hive, ETL, distributed data processing, SQL databases, performance/scalability, documentation, and AI/LLM integration themes.
body: At Citi, I built automated Python and Pandas ETL pipelines ingesting telemetry from more than 6,000 infrastructure endpoints and used PySpark/Spark patterns to process large-scale datasets for forecasting and analytics. That work included SQL/Oracle data modeling, validation, reporting layers, AWS data platform patterns, and documentation for data definitions, transformations, and operational workflows.

Earlier roles add software engineering depth that fits the backend and distributed systems aspects of this position. At Sabre, I led migration and validation work for a high-throughput shopping engine moving from MySQL to Oracle RAC, using C++, OCCI/OCI, SQL, and performance-sensitive validation tooling. Across Sprint/AMDOCS, AT&T, CA Technologies, and G6, I worked with Java/J2EE systems, WebLogic/WebSphere, MQ-style integrations, XML workflows, APIs, monitoring, and performance troubleshooting.

For the AI/LLM side, I bring practical project experience with LLM APIs, RAG concepts, vector embeddings, prompt workflow design, and JSON-based quality gates through my AI-powered job search pipeline and AWS/Bedrock-oriented learning projects. For areas like Spring Boot, Hibernate, Struts, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes/OpenShift, and healthcare analytics, I would be transparent: I bring adjacent backend, data, cloud, and AI pipeline experience and can ramp quickly on the specific stack.
conclusion: I would welcome the opportunity to contribute as a senior engineer focused on scalable data processing, backend integration, performance, documentation, and practical AI-enabled product capabilities.
